source_of_truth_mapping.overview: Source of truth resolution rules across duplicates, backups, and historical snapshots.
precedence_hierarchy: 1. Active Workspace Reports (remediation branch HEAD): Authoritative canonical monographs for all current analysis and research.
2. .bak.md Files: Historical pre-enhancement backups created prior to multi-agent rewrites. Disposable after verification.
3. baseline_snapshot/: Immutable archival baseline preserved under tag pre-fix. Read-only historical reference.
4. review/ Monograph & Registers: Independent peer review and formal evaluation layer; secondary analytical authority.

bak_files_summary.action_recommendation: Retain intact on remediation branch until Step 20 cleanup pass; never treat as current source of truth.

duplicate_filenames_summary.primary_cause: Parallel structure in baseline_snapshot/ mirroring active workspace directories, plus .bak.md pairing.
duplicate_filenames_summary.resolution: Active workspace path (e.g. "4th Turning/...") is authoritative; baseline_snapshot/ is strictly historical reference.
